scripts.bootstrap:assets: sh -c 'cd ../.. && export PORT=4002 MIX_ENV=test E2E=1 MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/test-e2e && mix assets.setup && mix assets.build'
scripts.bootstrap:db: sh -c 'cd ../.. && export PORT=4002 MIX_ENV=test E2E=1 MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/test-e2e && mix ecto.create --quiet && mix ecto.migrate --quiet && mix run test/support/e2e/bootstrap.exs'
scripts.bootstrap: npm run bootstrap:assets && npm run bootstrap:db
